study type: Mixed methods (online questionnaire and focus groups)
exposure: Factors influencing weight change during and post-pregnancy
outcome: Women's experience of changes in body weight during and post-pregnancy
Potential strategies to help manage weight
cohort: The study included women aged 18-45 years-old who had an uncomplicated pregnancy within the last 3 years.
finding: Mothers reported receiving insufficient information around weight management, with barriers identified at intrapersonal, interpersonal, environment and society, and institutional and policy levels of the ecological model.
cross-section timing: Retrospective data collected on experiences during pregnancy and up to 3 years postpartum
